learning_outcomes.text: Describe the environmental foundations of early civilisations in Mesopotamia, Egypt, the Indus and China
Explain how writing, law and administration developed to manage complex societies
Analyse religion, kingship and monumental architecture as expressions of political power
Compare the classical Mediterranean worlds of Greece and Rome
Explain economic, social and gender structures in selected ancient societies
Evaluate how archaeologists and historians reconstruct the ancient past from fragmentary evidence

integrative_case: A travelling exhibition receives a crate of unlabelled Old World artefacts: date and attribute each to a civilisation using material, script and iconography, explain the reasoning and uncertainty, and draft honest gallery labels that distinguish evidence from inference.
